conventions.inputs: Finite Float64 converted by Fraction.from_float; JSON hexadecimal companions are authoritative.
conventions.reversal: Inclusive positive-weight filtered-base bounds; exact L+U-x rounded once to Float64.
conventions.cohort: Original complete cohort retained for all deletions; integer frequency is literal replication.
conventions.exact: Rational means/scatter/raw alpha/correlation squared; standardized square roots use mpmath.
conventions.precision: 80/160/320/640 decimal digits; independent direct standardized energy and correlation matrix identity.
conventions.limits: Small fixtures only; convergence is evidence, not a Rust error allowance or correct-rounding proof.
